frozen_scope.purpose: Describe where signed long-context value occurs within speech and silence event structure on development data.
frozen_scope.sequence_position: AX3 after completed AX1 and AX2 and before AX4

event_definitions.ground_truth_boundary_role: Ground-truth boundaries and run lengths are explanatory strata only. They are not claimed to be available to a causal router.
event_definitions.causal_feature_role: Recent posterior transition and uncertainty duration use only current and previous Short scores within an utterance and are causally deployable diagnostics.
event_definitions.utterance_reset_rule: All distances, run lengths, prediction-switch ages, and uncertainty streaks reset at every contiguous source/noise/condition utterance variant.

onset_distance.distance_definition: frames since the start of the current speech run; first speech frame has distance 0

offset_distance.applicable: ground-truth non-speech frames after a completed speech run
offset_distance.distance_definition: frames since the first non-speech frame after the most recent speech run; first post-speech frame has distance 0

speech_run_length.length_definition: full length of the speech run containing the frame

silence_run_length.length_definition: full length of the silence run containing the frame

recent_posterior_transition.distance_definition: age of the most recent Short-prediction switch in the current utterance; a switch at the current frame has age 0; no switch yet is none

recent_uncertainty_duration.distance_definition: length of the consecutive uncertain Short-posterior streak ending at the current frame; a certain frame has duration 0

contrasts.test: Frames within five frames of a speech onset have different mean signed value than established speech frames.
Frames within five frames of a speech offset have different mean signed value than later post-offset frames.
Frames in speech runs of at most 20 frames have different mean signed value than frames in longer speech runs.
Frames in silence runs of at most 20 frames have different mean signed value than frames in longer silence runs.
Frames within five frames of a Short-prediction switch have different mean signed value than frames far from or without a switch.
Frames in persistent uncertainty streaks have different mean signed value than certain frames.

bootstrap.resampling_rule: One shared cluster resample matrix is used for every dimension, bin, and paired contrast.
bootstrap.finite_sample_rule: A bootstrap replicate with zero denominator for a metric is excluded only from that metric's interval.

assessment.interpretation: At least one predefined event-structure contrast has a material paired net-value difference with a speaker-cluster 95% CI excluding zero and calibration/test sign consistency. This is descriptive and does not authorize a new router.
assessment.interpretation_limit: AX3 is descriptive. No status authorizes a new router, changes the frozen gate, or changes A14.
